tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the WebSupergoo documentation and web site. Returns the best-matching sections, each with where it is in the documentation, its id, URL and a snippet. tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List the products (ids for the product parameter), with where each one's documentation starts, and the content types (ids for the type parameter).

tools.name: contents
tools.description: Where a page is in the documentation, and what is around it: the folder it is in, the pages next to it (for a property, the class's other properties) or the pages it contains. Without an id, the top of the contents.

tools.name: report_issue
tools.description: Tell the WebSupergoo team about a documentation problem, so they can fix it. tools.name: lookup_api
tools.description: Find a class or member of a WebSupergoo API by name - Doc.AddImageUrl, AddImageUrl, XImage.SetFile - even partial or misspelt. tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Read a documentation page as Markdown, by the id that search, lookup_api or contents gave - or by its websupergoo.com URL. A section id (page.md#2) with section_only gives just that section.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "search" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
